summary: The agent successfully completed the course catalog diff task using the existing dataset-diff skill. Key observations: (1) Course terminology like 'removed_courses' and 'revised_courses' was missing from domain mappings - the skill only had 'schools/universities' but not 'courses'. (2) The task required only removed and revised outputs (no added courses) where --omit-empty would be ideal. Enhancing the skill with course-specific domain mappings and a dedicated course-catalog section will help future agents identify the correct output keys faster and avoid manual post-processing when the script flags suffice.
